title: Nanomaterial Toxicity Assay
author: Opentrons
materials: Bacteria are removed from the nanosheets and the nanosheets are washed with PBS. (Plate ready for imaging on the Opera Phenix) --- * [Opentrons P300-multi channel electronic pipettes (GEN2)](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-robot/products/8-channel-electronic-pipette?variant=5984202489885) * [Opentrons 200ul Filter Tips](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips/products/opentrons-200ul-filter-tips) * [NEST 1 Well Reservoir 195 mL](http://www.cell-nest.com/page94?_l=en&product_id=102) * [NEST 12-Well Reservoirs, 15 mL](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/verified-labware/products/nest-12-well-reservoir-15-ml) * [NEST 96 Deepwell Plate 2mL](http://www.cell-nest.com/page94?product_id=101&_l=en) * [NEST 0.1 mL 96-Well PCR Plate, Full Skirt](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/verified-labware/products/nest-0-1-ml-96-well-pcr-plate-full-skirt) * [OMNI Pre-filled 2 mL 96 deep well plates with 1.4 mm Ceramic beads](https://www.omni-inc.com/consumables/well-plates/2-pack-96-well-plate-1-4mm-ceramic.html) * [MagMAX Plant DNA Isolation Kit](https://www.thermofisher.com/order/catalog/product/A32549#/A32549)

steps.title: Load labware and dispense nanomaterials
steps.instruction: Load all required labware (Opentrons P300‑multi‑channel GEN2 pipettes, 200 µL filter tips, NEST 1‑well reservoir (195 mL), NEST 12‑well reservoirs (15 mL), NEST 96‑deepwell plate (2 mL), NEST 0.1 mL 96‑well PCR plate, OMNI pre‑filled 2 mL 96‑deep‑well plates with 1.4 mm ceramic beads, and MagMAX Plant DNA Isolation Kit). Prepare nanomaterial solutions in the 12‑well reservoir as follows: column 1 – 1:10 GO, column 2 – 1:100 GO, column 3 – undiluted MoS₂, column 4 – 1:10 MoS₂, column 5 – undiluted MoSe₂, column 6 – 1:10 MoSe₂. Using the P300‑multi‑channel, dispense the appropriate volumes of each solution into the experimental 384‑well plate to achieve the desired concentration series. After dispensing, remove the 384‑well plate from the OT‑2 robot and dry it at 60 °C.

substeps.instruction: Load all required labware and tip racks onto the OT‑2 deck.
Fill the 12‑well reservoir columns with the specified nanomaterial dilutions.
Program the P300‑multi‑channel to transfer the nanomaterial solutions into the 384‑well plate wells.
After the run, transfer the plate to a dry oven and incubate at 60 °C until completely dry.

steps.title: Wash nanosheets and add bacteria
steps.instruction: Load all labware again, this time including the live bacterial culture. Perform a PBS wash of the dried nanosheets in the 384‑well plate, then add the bacterial suspension to each well. Incubate the plate at 37.5 °C for 5 hours outside the OT‑2.

substeps.instruction: Load the 384‑well plate, PBS reservoir, and bacterial culture onto the deck.
Add PBS to each well to wash the nanosheets, then remove the PBS.
Dispense the bacterial suspension into each well containing the washed nanosheets.
Place the plate in an incubator set to 37.5 °C for 5 hours.

steps.title: Final PBS wash and prepare for imaging
steps.instruction: Load the plate and PBS again, wash the nanosheets to remove bacteria, and then set the plate aside for imaging on the Opera Phenix system.

substeps.instruction: Load the 384‑well plate and fresh PBS onto the deck.
Add PBS to each well, gently mix, and remove the PBS to wash away bacteria.
Leave the washed nanosheet‑coated plate ready for imaging on the Opera Phenix.
